prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add an `import-csv` command requiring `--path`. CSV rows require a nonblank `Title`; `Description` is optional and `Status` may be blank, `pending`, or `completed`. Validate the entire file before changing storage, import valid rows with unique sequential IDs, and leave storage untouched if any row is invalid. Support `--json` with a stable summary containing imported count and IDs. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/import.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON imports display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `IMPORT`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

Text import renders the exact registered banner once before its expected count result.

+                    $status = $statusText.Trim()
+                    if ($status -notin @('', 'pending', 'completed')) {
+                        throw "CSV row $rowNumber has invalid Status '$status'."
+                    }
+
+                    [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                        title = ([string]$row.Title).Trim()
+                        description = if ($row.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Description') {
+                            [string]$row.Description

+                    [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                        id = $nextId++

+                        description = $row.description
+                        status = $row.status
+                        createdAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
+                    }
+                }
+            )
+            Write-TaskStore -Path $dataFile -Tasks @($tasks + $imported)
+

+                ids = @($imported.id)
+            }

+                Write-TaskForgeOutput -Value $summary -AsJson $true
+            }
+            else {
+                Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt')
+                $idText = if ($summary.ids.Count -eq 0) { 'none' } else { $summary.ids -join ', ' }
+                "Imported $($summary.importedCount) task(s). IDs: $idText"
+            }

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $missingPath = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingPath.ExitCode -ne 0) 'import-csv should require --path'

    $existing = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Existing task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($existing.ExitCode -eq 0) 'setup task for import should succeed'

    $csvFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.csv'
    @'
Title,Description,Status
Imported pending,Optional description,
Imported complete,,completed
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $csvFile
    $importJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $csvFile, '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($importJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'import-csv --json should succeed'
    $importSummary = $importJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($importSummary.importedCount -eq 2) 'import-csv should report the imported count'
    Assert-True (($importSummary.ids -join ',') -eq '2,3') 'import-csv should report unique sequential IDs after existing tasks'
    Assert-True (-not $importJson.Output.Contains('IMPORT')) 'JSON import output should not contain the banner'

    $storedImports = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json))
    Assert-True ($storedImports.Count -eq 3) 'import-csv should append every valid row'
    Assert-True ($storedImports[1].status -eq 'pending' -and $storedImports[2].status -eq 'completed') 'import-csv should normalize blank status and preserve completed status'

    $invalidCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid.csv'
    @'
Title,Status
Valid row,pending
Invalid row,blocked
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $invalidCsv
    $beforeInvalidImport = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $invalidImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $invalidCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidImport.ExitCode -ne 0) 'import-csv should reject an invalid row'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -ceq $beforeInvalidImport) 'invalid import should leave storage untouched'

    $blankTitleCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'blank-title.csv'
    "Title,Description`n   ,No title" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $blankTitleCsv
    $blankTitle = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $blankTitleCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($blankTitle.ExitCode -ne 0) 'import-csv should reject a blank Title'

    $minimalCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'minimal.csv'
    "Title,Status`nNo description column,pending" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $minimalCsv
    $nonJsonDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'non-json-tasks.json'
    $nonJsonImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $minimalCsv, '--data-file', $nonJsonDataFile)
    Assert-True ($nonJsonImport.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON import-csv should succeed'
    Assert-True (([regex]::Matches($nonJsonImport.Output, [regex]::Escape('IMPORT ASSET BANNER'))).Count -eq 1) 'non-JSON import should display the banner once'
    Assert-True ($nonJsonImport.Output.Contains('Imported 1 task(s). IDs: 1')) 'non-JSON import should display a stable summary'
    Assert-True (((Get-Content -LiteralPath $nonJsonDataFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).description) -eq '') 'Description column should be optional'

    $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt'
    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerLines = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($bannerPath)
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'import banner should have exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'import banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (@($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0) 'import banner should be ASCII only'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '[^A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*.#():=\-]' }).Count -eq 0) 'import banner should use only allowed characters'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0) 'import banner should not have trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True (($bannerLines -join "`n").Contains('IMPORT')) 'import banner should contain IMPORT'
    Assert-True ($bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and $bannerBytes[-2] -ne 10) 'import banner should end with exactly one newline'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('import-csv --path PATH')) 'help should document import-csv'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 33 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
